title: The Hidden Laboratory Where Scientists Grew a Human Ear on a Rat's Back
hook: In a secret lab, scientists grew a fully-formed human ear on the back of a living rat — and it had a pulse.

why_this_can_go_viral: It's a tragic, almost human story about an animal that learned to talk — and was then abandoned. The emotional hook is immense.
